tables.name: Beneath the Surface - Awareness
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. How much awareness there is of what is going on beneath the surface.

results.name: Utterly Oblivious
results.description: The public has not seen, or heard, any hint of whatever is going on. It will go unchecked until something triggers a change.

results.name: Single, Subtle Occurrence
results.description: Someone has noticed some kind of evidence, but doesn’t quite know what to make of it. They just know it’s strange.

results.name: Disparate, Subtle Occurrences
results.description: A few people have passively encountered some evidence of what’s going on, though they are not aware of one another, and are not sure about what they’ve encountered.

results.name: Many Subtle Occurrences
results.description: A fair amount of people have encountered something related to what’s going on and, while firm conclusions have not been drawn, there may be rumors.

results.name: Single Occurrence
results.description: Someone has noticed something, and has formed some ideas. They have started to ask questions, or poke around a bit.

results.name: Disparate Occurrences
results.description: A few people have noticed evidence, and are beginning to ask serious questions.

results.name: Many Occurrences
results.description: A fair amount of people have noticed evidence, and are beginning to ask serious questions. Some may even have found one another and pooled their knowledge.

results.name: Single, Direct Occurrence
results.description: Someone has had a direct, first-hand experience involving the issue, and is trying to deal with it somehow.

results.name: Disparate, Direct Occurrences
results.description: A few people have had direct, first-hand experiences involving the issue, and word is starting to spread. Claims have become difficult to dismiss.

results.name: Many Direct Occurrences
results.description: A fair amount of people have had direct, first-hand experiences involving the issue. Talk seems to be all over the place, and some of the witnesses have grouped together.

results.name: Willfully Ignorant
results.description: The public is fully aware of most, or all, of the issue, but deliberately avoids addressing it or dealing with it in any way.

results.name: Actively Aware
results.description: The public is fully aware, and actively addressing whatever is going on.
